data.one_liner: Send and manage notifications on Windows using Flutter
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter Windows applications to send native notifications using built-in or custom XML templates, clear notification history, handle notification actions, and receive notification events.
use_when: You are building a Flutter desktop application targeted specifically for Windows
You need to display native Windows toast notifications with ready-made or custom templates
avoid_when: You need a cross-platform notification solution supporting mobile or web platforms
You are working with push notification services rather than local Windows notifications
strengths: Supports both plugin-provided ready-made templates and custom XML templates
Provides notification event handling and deep linking support
Allows clearing notifications from the Windows Action Center by ID or group
weaknesses: Limited only to the Windows platform
Requires proper application ID configuration depending on the packaging mode
data.setup_notes: Initialize the WindowsNotification instance with your application name or ID.

alternatives.name: flutter_local_notifications
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a cross-platform local notification solution instead of a Windows-only plugin.
